recomputed_audit_work_not_new_labels.explanation: The descriptive replay process recomputes the already-known 8,192 menu and 384 prediction values. A physical experiment could reuse those existing labels. Valuing literal synthetic re-evaluation as fresh expensive queries adds 8,576 units. Healthy diagnostic outputs are also numerically recomputed for alternative methods rather than collected anew; common-label accounting does not charge that arithmetic repeatedly.

other_work_and_limits: Origin coefficient replay uses 128 stored observations. It consumes zero new oracle queries but nonzero unmetered fitting compute.

Plotting, source checks, statistical bootstraps, economic simulations, native conformance and review probes do not consume new scientific-oracle labels; their engineering time, CPU and energy costs are unmeasured.

conditional_contribution_classification: USD 44.775 for v2 versus USD 16.4041667 for direct Beta is simulated mean operating contribution per attempt. It includes failed-attempt query costs, assumed model/tool/service/invocation/payment costs, plus v2 B of 90/20 and Gym C of 128/20. It excludes the common opportunity-development and research campaign of 617,544 units. It uses the hidden compatible-family stratum descriptively and assumes each accepted contract collects USD 100. It is not realized profit, whole-study profit, validated demand, or an admissible policy that routes jobs using hidden family labels.
